Messages.Author: umur...@cc.umanitoba.ca
Messages.Body:
Hello, all.

I have a brief question regarding chainsaws, shotguns, and other
weapons which are only useable once per combat. Now, does that mean
you can't press with them, or that they may only be ONE strike?

Example:

Vampire A is fighting Vampire B. Vampire A, using a chainsaw,
inflicts three points of damage on B, and then presses. Vampire A
cannot use the chainsaw again this round. Correct?

Vampire A vs B. A uses a chainsaw on B, and then blurs, doing two
more strikes. Can A still use the chainsaws for the other strikes
this round, or only for the first strike?

Another question, naturally.

With regards to cards like carrion crows that aren't strikes, per se.
Do they still inflict damage on enemies who use Strike: Combat Ends
cards?

Eg I have a Shadow Court Satyr (damn you, Lee!) with Earth Meld as its
chosen strike card. If carrion crows are played, does the Satyr take
damage from them before the combat ends?

Messages.Author: Skippy
Messages.Body:

Chainsaw
Cost 2pool
Weapon. 3 damage as a strike. Usable only once per combat.

Gas-Powered Chainsaw
Cost 1pool
Melee Weapon.
3 damage as a strike only usable once each combat

Talbot's Chainsaw
Cost 3pool
Unique weapon. 3 damage each strike. If bearer is ready during your untap
phase, a ready minion you control takes 3 damage (damage not preventable).
Bearer cannot hunt. Bearer may enter combat with any minion controlled by
another Methusela as a +1 stealth (D) action. Bearer get a press, only
usable to continue combat at the end of the first round, and may prevent up
to 1 damage each combat.

Combat Shotgun
Weapon, Gun.
Cost 3pool
3R damage each strike, only usable once each round.

Sawed-off Shotgun
Weapon, Gun.
Cost 2pool
3R damage as a strike only usable once per combat.

This should clear things up.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
umur...@cc.umanitoba.ca wrote:
>
> Hello, all.
>
> I have a brief question regarding chainsaws, shotguns, and other
> weapons which are only useable once per combat. Now, does that mean
> you can't press with them, or that they may only be ONE strike?

The latter. "Once per combat" is not the same as "during only one round".

> Example:
>
> Vampire A is fighting Vampire B. Vampire A, using a chainsaw,
> inflicts three points of damage on B, and then presses. Vampire A
> cannot use the chainsaw again this round. Correct?

Right. It can only be used once that combat.

> Vampire A vs B. A uses a chainsaw on B, and then blurs, doing two
> more strikes. Can A still use the chainsaws for the other strikes
> this round, or only for the first strike?

Only for one strike. It can only be used once in the combat.

> Another question, naturally.
>
> With regards to cards like carrion crows that aren't strikes, per se.
> Do they still inflict damage on enemies who use Strike: Combat Ends
> cards?

Not if they do damage duing strike resolution (like Carrion Crows), no.

> Eg I have a Shadow Court Satyr (damn you, Lee!) with Earth Meld as its
> chosen strike card. If carrion crows are played, does the Satyr take
> damage from them before the combat ends?

No.
